literal: Having erred even if understood, foolishness they will not say, having examined minutely and understood, accumulated learning-by-hearing they.
translation: Even if they have misunderstood something by mistake, those who have accumulated learning through subtle examination and understanding will not speak foolish words.
modern: நுட்பமாக ஆராய்ந்து உணர்ந்து பெற்ற கேள்வியறிவை உடையவர்கள், ஒருவேளை தவறாகப் புரிந்து கொண்டிருந்தாலும், பேதைமையான சொற்களைச் சொல்ல மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the maturity of those who have gained deep knowledge through attentive listening. The phrase 'இழைத்து உணர்ந்து ஈண்டிய கேள்வி' refers to learning that is accumulated by minutely examining and truly understanding what is heard. Because their foundation is so thorough, even if they happen to misunderstand a specific point ('பிழைத்து உணர்ந்தும்'), they will restrain themselves and not blurt out foolish or ignorant words ('பேதைமை சொல்லார்'). Their deep learning gives them the wisdom to avoid speaking rashly.
